root_cause: The Verified Value P0 feature was merged to protected main, but Netlify production still served the prior commit. The canonical Production Source Snapshot only self-triggers on a change to its workflow path, so an explicit same-lineage operational refresh is required to deploy and prove the exact current main source.
prevention_rule: When a material feature is merged but production commit_ref remains behind, use the canonical Production Source Snapshot/OIDC-to-Netlify route and carry Brain learning, activity ledger and human documentation in the same promotion lineage. Never claim LIVE_BEWEZEN from merge state alone.

invariants: promotion uses canonical Production Source Snapshot workflow
exact production commit identity is proven before LIVE_BEWEZEN
production commit must contain or descend from the feature merge
material promotion carries learning ledger and human documentation
